BrochureContent.Content:
No.18 Fr Angelus Park is a three bedroom mid-terrace house, exceptionally well located in a mature residential cul-de-sac, just 500 metres from Westport town centre.

The property was originally built in the early 50s but has been modernised in part over the years. The floor area extends to approximately 70 sq m/750 sq ft with ground floor accommodation comprising of an entrance hall, living room, kitchenette and wet room. 

On the first floor, there are three bedrooms, two double(with fireplaces) and one single. The property is presented in good condition throughout.

Externally, there is a small garden to the front overlooking the large communal green area, and a long north west facing back garden. Also to the rear of the property is a boiler house/fuel shed (3.0m x 2.45m).

Father Angelus Park is situated off the Castlebar Road with a footpath available to walk to the town. Westport's many amenities are within easy reach of the property including two secondary schools, primary schools, supermarkets, sports clubs, bars and restaurants.
